title: MULEMBA XANGOLA FESTIVAL
description:
✨ MULEMBA XANGOLA FESTIVAL – 1st Edition | LUXEMBOURG ✨
For the first time, we proudly present a new concept that celebrates the richness of Angolan culture. This festival is designed to offer a unique and immersive experience—bringing the true Angolan feeling to Luxembourg through dance, music, gastronomy, and tradition.
🎶 What to expect:
• Live dance performances & stage shows
• Angolan cultural presentations
• Traditional Angolan food
• A refined Grand Gala with red-carpet entrance (elegant attire required)
More than an event, this is a celebration of positivity, energy, learning, and connection. A weekend where cultures meet, stories are shared, and one dance family comes together.
Get ready for an unforgettable experience where tradition takes center stage and two worlds unite through dance.
🗓️13-14-15 NOVEMBER 2026
